QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The City is Risen
QuestInfo.0: The World Heart reacts to Tallahart, reviving the city in a flash of light. Are the ancient gods awakening because of your power? Discuss your course of action with Hawkeye.
QuestInfo.1: The World Heart reacts to Tallahart, reviving the city in a flash of light. Are the ancient gods awakening because of your power? Discuss your course of action with Hawkeye.
QuestInfo.2: En route to Tallahart, you found a girl named #bLuce#k. She said she's a Seeker and asked that you escort her to the city in exchange for her guiding you and Hawkeye through the illusions.
